name: List Custom Object Types
summary: Lists the custom object TYPES (the schemas) in your instance, with optional filtering by name and version state.
whenToUse: Admin view: see what custom object types exist (draft vs approved) and their key fields.

query.name: state
query.label: Version state

options.label: Approved, plus draft if there is one

query.hint: Custom object types have draft and approved versions; this picks which to show.

query.name: names
query.label: Limit to names
query.hint: Optional comma-separated API names to restrict the result.

response.description: Type metadata: state, version, displayName, apiName, dedupeFields, searchableFields, relationships.

notes: Max 10 custom object types and 50 fields per type per Marketo's limits.
